root_motivation: **Who:** an org owner (PRD-mcphost-org-model) who must be verified for members > 3 and for the weekly digest; an agent that cannot read email. **What:** a second and third way to prove "a human stands behind this tenant". **Why not today:** `verify_claim_code` is the only writer of `owner_verified_at` (`db.rs:652-663`); `claim.rs:78` short-circuits on an already-verified tenant but every entry point needs `owner_email`; `oauth_providers` (0052) brokers end users of a tenant's product, not the tenant's owner; `owner_verified` in whoami (`control.rs:1249`) and `admin.tenants` (`admin.rs:117`) is a bool with no provenance. **Consequence:** every verified tenant is an inbox; an agent-first team with a GitHub org and a domain has the slowest path.
user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the `VERIFICATION_METHODS` const, When the drift test runs, Then every method's tool name resolves to a handler arm, each `host.claim.*` descriptor's `method` enum equals the const, and `/claim/methods.json` equals it.

Given `MCPHOST_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` set and a stubbed GitHub token endpoint, When the callback arrives with a valid state and code, Then the tenant is verified with `method = github, handle = <login>`; Given an expired or unknown state, Then 400 and nothing is written.
Given the GitHub env unset, When `host.claim.github` runs, Then `method_unavailable {method: "github"}` and `/claim/methods.json` still lists `github` with `available: false`.
Given a tenant already verified by email, When it runs `host.claim.dns.check` with a matching record, Then `already_verified {method: "email"}` and `owner_method` is unchanged.
Given two concurrent `dns.check` calls for the same tenant, When both match, Then exactly one writes and one `tenant_audit` row `claim.dns` exists.
Given an unverified tenant, When `host.quickstart` is read, Then `next` names email, github and dns from the generated table.

scope: src/notes.rs: host.note.put/list/delete over the notes/ prefix of tenant_state_kv; the tools/list description suffix.
src/handler.rs, src/protocol/frames.rs: tools, dispatch, list_changed on a tool-attached put/delete (keyed row allows list_changed).
src/plans.rs, src/retention.rs, src/db.rs: notes_max plan field; expired-note sweep.
contracts/, docs/, www/: regenerated tool contract, output schemas, docs.
non_goals: Notes attached to runs surfaced in host.runs.get (R6), attached_to in host.resume/welcome_back (R5), pin (R7); shared notebooks across tenants.

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the next session repeat a mistake the last one learned from?
five_whys_trace.a: The only write path is remember at signup; nothing pins a note to the tool it is about.
